mutations.label: lifecycle: only a finite guard stamp inside the window holds the sweep (Codex, §146)
mutations.from: if (Number.isFinite(last) && last <= now && now - last < SAID_SWEEP_INTERVAL_MS) return false
mutations.only: ^(?:only a finite guard stamp inside the window holds the sweep)$

mutations.label: 2026-10-09: the session-log sweep runs once a day
mutations.from:
if (!claimDailySweep(guard, now, report)) return report
  report.swept = true
  const own
mutations.to:
claimDailySweep(guard, now, report)
  report.swept = true
  const own
mutations.only: ^a week-old session log is swept, unless it holds a write git could not see$
